items.title: Blumhouse Productions, LLC
items.summary: Blumhouse Productions, LLC is an American film Production company founded by Jason Blum and Amy Israel in 2000.  The company is known for making horror films such as the Paranormal Activity series, Get Out, and Split.

items.title: Chica's Party World
items.summary: Chica's Party World was a restaurant owned by Chica's Restaurants that commissioned Murray's Costume Manor for animatronics in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic.  It was first mentioned in the source code of Scottgames.

items.title: Party Time Chica
items.summary: Party Time Chica is a mascot suit that debuts in Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic as a suit that the Mimic wears.
